zh-HK: 產品資料庫加入 Margin Class（2026，未有就用 2025）及產地 Country of Origin（Product of XXX）
存貨資料加入 Group Status（Delisted／Continued／New／Vacant）、Sustainable selection（Planet／People／Community By Lyreco）及舊制 Green Product
報價行、編輯視窗及產品搜尋顯示 ⛔ Delisted、🆕 New、🌍 Planet、🤝 People、🏘️ Community、🌿 Green 及產地標籤；Delisted 行加紅色左邊線
上載新版 Power BI 存貨 Excel 時按表頭讀取欄位（Available Stock 移咗去 L 欄都唔會讀錯）
資料更新工具：產品卡可另加 Margin Class Excel；存貨卡支援新欄位並顯示 Group Status 統計
快速批量輸入新增「標籤快速過濾」：🆕 New／🌍 Planet／🤝 People／🏘️ Community／🌿 Green（符合任何一個或全部）及 ⛔ 排除 Delisted；唔輸入編號／關鍵字、唔揀類別，只揀標籤就可以直接加入全部符合產品
零食套餐新增「Product of」產地欄、產地篩選及「🚫 排除產地」（移除指定產地產品，Load from Quotation 亦自動略過，可復原）
零食套餐新增 Health／Non-health 欄：逐行或批量設定、可篩選，Health Check 顯示 Health 比例，Excel 匯出包括產地及 Health；標記會記住俾下次載入
產品資料庫加入 Non Returnable（Margin Class 檔）：報價行、編輯視窗及產品搜尋顯示 🚫 Non Returnable 標籤；快速批量輸入可按此標籤加入或「排除 Non Returnable」
零食套餐：未有 Product of 嘅產品可以自行輸入產地（有建議清單，會記住）；自動配貨新增「按 Health snack 比例配貨」（例如 Health 70%／Non-health 30%），未設定嘅項目可揀唔配、當 Health 或當 Non-health
零食套餐圖片：撳圖片只會開 E-Shop 連結；更換圖片改用圖片右上角 ✏️（手機常駐顯示），冇圖嘅項目有「＋ 加圖片」
自動配貨：新增「🚫 排除產地」（只影響今次配貨，會記住揀選）；改其中一個分類目標 % 時，其餘分類按原本比例自動調整，合計保持 100%
零食套餐模板：載入後改完可撳「💾 Update」直接覆蓋原模板（顯示目前模板名稱）；新增 Export／Import JSON（全部或單個模板，可多選檔案，重複自動略過，亦接受套餐 Export JSON）
en: Product database now carries Margin Class (2026, falling back to 2025) and Country of Origin
Stock data now carries Group Status (Delisted / Continued / New / Vacant), Sustainable selection (Planet / People / Community by Lyreco) and old-mode Green Product
Quotation rows, the edit modal and product search show Delisted, New, Planet, People, Community, Green and origin badges; delisted rows get a red left edge
Stock Excel upload now maps columns by header, so the new Power BI layout (Available Stock in column L) is read correctly
Data updater: optional Margin Class Excel for products; stock builder reads the new columns and reports Group Status counts

Quick Batch Entry: tag quick filter for New / Planet / People / Community / Green (any or all) plus Exclude Delisted; ticking tags with no item codes, keywords or categories adds every matching product directly
Snack Package: new Product of (origin) column, origin filter and Exclude origins (removes those products, also skipped on Load from Quotation, with undo)
Snack Package: new Health / Non-health column with per-row and batch setting, filter, Health share in Health Check and Excel export; tags are remembered per product
Product database now carries Non Returnable from the Margin Class file: shown as a badge on rows, the edit modal and search; Quick Batch Entry can filter by it or exclude it

Snack Package: enter the origin yourself when Product of is missing (with suggestions, remembered per product); Auto Build can split by Health snack ratio (e.g. 70% Health / 30% Non-health), with a choice for untagged items
Snack Package images: clicking an image only opens the e-shop link; change it with the ✏️ button on the image (always visible on touch), or "+ Add image" when there is none
Auto Build: new Exclude origins (Product of) for that build, remembered; editing one category target % rebalances the others proportionally so the total stays 100%

Snack Package templates: after loading, "💾 Update" overwrites the loaded template (current name shown); new Export / Import JSON for all or single templates (multi-file, duplicates skipped, package JSON accepted)
